1 of ?

One of my roommates sexually assaulted me at 3AM this morning. Opened my closed bedroom door & began doing what he wanted.  I woke up to him over me. I was shocked.   What's worse is the police. I never reported a rape in 92' or the 4 assaults since...
#MeToo
#Victims

2 of ?

Today, I ended that cycle and called the police. However, the way I've been treated is exactly why I never reported before.  Including an officer who just now laughed at  me on the phone when inquiring when the 72 hours starts. I was the ''alleged victim'' ...
#MeToo

3 of ?

..stated he couldn't tell me. But the officer I spoke to hours earlier, a woman, told me to call back for the information once he'd seen the judge. Additionally, a cop from this morning asked me if I really wanted to press charges, since I have to live with him...
#MeToo

4 of ?

The laws need to change. Because he's a roommate, the charge will not be sexual assault, it will be domestic battery or even disorderly conduct.  This is because we live in the same dwelling & he's not some random man. I told the cop, he IS some random man to me.
#MeToo

5 of 5

I want all victims and survivors to know, you must report.  The attitudes and behaviors towards us need to stop. 
#ItEndsToday
#Metoo
#VictimsRights
#SexualAssault
